content_units: Two-Person Movie Night Shortlist
Best fit for your preferences:   smart, engaging, low-gore, under-130-minute movies with strong character work and a satisfying finish  .
I filtered out the over-length options first and then ranked the remaining titles by how well they match your sci-fi, mystery, and clever-comedy taste.
Ranked Picks for Tonight
Rank   Film   Runtime   Genre   Why it fits   Content cautions

1     Arrival     116 min   Sci-fi/drama   Thoughtful sci-fi with excellent character depth, emotional payoff, and no reliance on gore or horror.   Intense emotional themes, some grief-related material, brief tense moments.

2     Knives Out     130 min   Mystery/comedy   A very satisfying and witty whodunit with sharp writing, strong ensemble character work, and a fun ending.   Mild violence, brief blood, some family conflict and profanity.

3     Palm Springs     90 min   Rom-com/sci-fi   Fast, clever, and emotionally warmer than it first appears, with a genuinely satisfying ending for a light movie night.   Sexual content, profanity, some reckless behavior and mild violence.

4     The Nice Guys     116 min   Comedy/mystery   Great chemistry and smart comedy make it a strong fit if you want something funny with mystery momentum.   More violence than the top 3, some blood, strong language, sexual references.

5     Her     126 min   Sci-fi/romance   Strong character development and reflective sci-fi ideas make it a good fit if you want something more intimate than plot-heavy.   Mature themes, sexual content, some emotional heaviness and loneliness.
Why These Beat the Other Options
-   Ex Machina   is excellent and under 130 minutes, but it has a colder tone and less traditionally satisfying ending than your top matches.
-   Game Night   is very fun and easy to watch, but character development is lighter than the five ranked above.
-   Prisoners  ,   Gone Girl  , and   The Martian   miss your runtime preference, with the first two also leaning darker and more intense.
Best Match by Mood
Option 1:   Arrival     Best overall fit if you want meaningful sci-fi with emotional depth     Most aligned with all preferences
Option 2:   Knives Out     Best if you want an entertaining, clever, crowd-pleasing mystery     Most satisfying mystery ending
Option 3:   Palm Springs     Best if you want something lighter, shorter, and easy to enjoy together     Most relaxed movie-night pick
Quick Actions
- Start with   Arrival   if you want the strongest all-around fit.
- Pick   Knives Out   if the priority is a clever, satisfying mystery with more laughs.
- Choose   Palm Springs   if you want the easiest, breeziest watch tonight.
